completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1312_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Madalanit, in the Municipality of Wright, Province of Samar, is hereby constituted into a barrio of said municipality to be known as the barrio of Madalanit.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1955.
